title: La roba (2)
author: Giovanni Verga
note: Part two of La roba: Mazzarò keeps buying land, but he is getting old. Remember: "disse" means "said", "fu" means "was".

segments.fr: Però ciascun anno tutti quei magazzini grandi come chiese
segments.en: But every year all those storehouses as big as churches

segments.fr: si riempivano di grano
segments.en: filled up with grain

segments.fr: che bisognava scoperchiare il tetto per farcelo capire tutto;
segments.en: so that you had to take the roof off to fit it all in;

segments.fr: e ogni volta che Mazzarò vendeva il vino,
segments.en: and every time Mazzarò sold his wine,

segments.fr: ci voleva più di un giorno per contare il denaro,
segments.en: it took more than a day to count the money,

segments.fr: tutto di dodici tarì d'argento,
segments.en: all in silver twelve-tarì coins,

segments.fr: chè lui non ne voleva di carta sudicia per la sua roba,
segments.en: for he didn't want any filthy paper money for his property,

segments.fr: e andava a comprare la carta sudicia
segments.en: and he went to buy filthy paper money

segments.fr: soltanto quando aveva da pagare il re, o gli altri;
segments.en: only when he had to pay the king, or other people;

segments.fr: e alle fiere gli armenti di Mazzarò coprivano tutto il campo,
segments.en: and at the fairs Mazzarò's herds covered the whole field,

segments.fr: e ingombravano le strade,
segments.en: and blocked the roads,

segments.fr: che ci voleva mezza giornata per lasciarli sfilare,
segments.en: so that it took half a day to let them file past,

segments.fr: e il santo, colla banda, alle volte dovevano mutar strada,
segments.en: and the saint's procession, with the band, sometimes had to change route,

segments.fr: e cedere il passo.
segments.en: and give way.

segments.fr: Tutta quella roba se l'era fatta lui,
segments.en: He had made all that property himself,

segments.fr: colle sue mani e colla sua testa, col non dormire la notte,
segments.en: with his hands and with his head, by not sleeping at night,

segments.fr: col prendere la febbre dal batticuore o dalla malaria,
segments.en: by catching fever from anxiety or from malaria,

segments.fr: coll'affaticarsi dall'alba a sera, e andare in giro,
segments.en: by wearing himself out from dawn to dusk, and going around,

segments.fr: sotto il sole e sotto la pioggia,
segments.en: under the sun and under the rain,

segments.fr: col logorare i suoi stivali e le sue mule;
segments.en: wearing out his boots and his mules;

segments.fr: egli solo non si logorava, pensando alla sua roba,
segments.en: he alone didn't wear out, thinking of his property,

segments.fr: ch'era tutto quello ch'ei avesse al mondo;
segments.en: which was all he had in the world;

segments.fr: perchè non aveva nè figli, nè nipoti, nè parenti;
segments.en: because he had no children, no grandchildren, no relatives;

segments.fr: non aveva altro che la sua roba.
segments.en: he had nothing but his property.

segments.fr: Quando uno è fatto così vuol dire che è fatto per la roba.
segments.en: When a man is made like that, it means he is made for property.

segments.fr: Ed anche la roba era fatta per lui,
segments.en: And property, too, was made for him,

segments.fr: che pareva ci avesse la calamita,
segments.en: it seemed as if he had a magnet for it,

segments.fr: perchè la roba vuol stare con chi sa tenerla,
segments.en: because property wants to stay with whoever knows how to keep it,

segments.fr: e non la sciupa come quel barone
segments.en: and doesn't waste it like that baron

segments.fr: che prima era stato il padrone di Mazzarò,
segments.en: who had once been Mazzarò's master,

segments.fr: e l'aveva raccolto per carità nudo e crudo ne' suoi campi,
segments.en: and had taken him in out of charity, penniless, on his fields,

segments.fr: ed era stato il padrone di tutti quei prati,
segments.en: and had been the owner of all those meadows,

segments.fr: e di tutti quei boschi, e di tutte quelle vigne
segments.en: and of all those woods, and of all those vineyards

segments.fr: e tutti quegli armenti,
segments.en: and all those herds,

segments.fr: che quando veniva nelle sue terre a cavallo coi campieri dietro,
segments.en: so that when he came to his lands on horseback with his guards behind,

segments.fr: pareva il re,
segments.en: he looked like the king,

segments.fr: e gli preparavano anche l'alloggio e il pranzo, al minchione,
segments.en: and they even got lodging and dinner ready for him, the fool,

segments.fr: sicché ognuno sapeva l'ora e il momento in cui doveva arrivare,
segments.en: so that everyone knew the hour and the moment he would arrive,

segments.fr: e non si faceva sorprendere colle mani nel sacco.
segments.en: and nobody let himself get caught red-handed.

segments.fr: «Costui vuol essere rubato per forza!» diceva Mazzarò,
segments.en: "That man just begs to be robbed!" Mazzarò used to say,

segments.fr: e schiattava dalle risa
segments.en: and he would burst with laughter

segments.fr: quando il barone gli dava dei calci nel di dietro,
segments.en: when the baron kicked him in the backside,

segments.fr: e si fregava la schiena colle mani, borbottando:
segments.en: and he rubbed his back with his hands, muttering:

segments.fr: «Chi è minchione se ne stia a casa»,
segments.en: "Whoever is a fool should stay at home,"

segments.fr: «la roba non è di chi l'ha, ma di chi la sa fare».
segments.en: "property doesn't belong to whoever has it, but to whoever knows how to make it."

segments.fr: Invece egli, dopo che ebbe fatta la sua roba,
segments.en: He, on the other hand, after he had made his property,

segments.fr: non mandava certo a dire se veniva a sorvegliare la mèsse,
segments.en: certainly didn't send word if he was coming to watch over the harvest,

segments.fr: o la vendemmia, e quando, e come;
segments.en: or the grape harvest, or when, or how;

segments.fr: ma capitava all'improvviso, a piedi, o a cavallo alla mula,
segments.en: but he turned up suddenly, on foot, or riding his mule,

segments.fr: senza campieri, con un pezzo di pane in tasca;
segments.en: without guards, with a piece of bread in his pocket;

segments.fr: e dormiva accanto ai suoi covoni, cogli occhi aperti,
segments.en: and he slept next to his sheaves, with his eyes open,

segments.fr: e lo schioppo fra le gambe.
segments.en: and his shotgun between his legs.

segments.fr: In tal modo a poco a poco
segments.en: In this way, little by little,

segments.fr: Mazzarò divenne il padrone di tutta la roba del barone;
segments.en: Mazzarò became the owner of all the baron's property;

segments.fr: e costui uscì prima dall'uliveto, e poi dalle vigne,
segments.en: and the baron left first the olive grove, and then the vineyards,

segments.fr: e poi dai pascoli, e poi dalle fattorie
segments.en: and then the pastures, and then the farms

segments.fr: e infine dal suo palazzo istesso,
segments.en: and finally his very own mansion,

segments.fr: che non passava giorno che non firmasse delle carte bollate,
segments.en: for not a day went by that he didn't sign stamped legal papers,

segments.fr: e Mazzarò ci metteva sotto la sua brava croce.
segments.en: and Mazzarò put his trusty cross underneath.

segments.fr: Al barone non era rimasto altro
segments.en: The baron had nothing left

segments.fr: che lo scudo di pietra ch'era prima sul portone,
segments.en: but the stone coat of arms that used to be over the main door,

segments.fr: ed era la sola cosa che non avesse voluto vendere,
segments.en: and it was the only thing he hadn't wanted to sell,

segments.fr: dicendo a Mazzarò:
segments.en: saying to Mazzarò:

segments.fr: «Questo solo, di tutta la mia roba, non fa per te.»
segments.en: "This alone, of all my property, is not for you."

segments.fr: Ed era vero; Mazzarò non sapeva che farsene,
segments.en: And it was true; Mazzarò had no use for it,

segments.fr: e non l'avrebbe pagato due baiocchi.
segments.en: and wouldn't have paid two pennies for it.

segments.fr: Il barone gli dava ancora del tu,
segments.en: The baron still spoke to him as "tu", like a servant,

segments.fr: ma non gli dava più calci nel di dietro.
segments.en: but he no longer kicked him in the backside.

segments.fr: «Questa è una bella cosa, d'avere la fortuna che ha Mazzarò!»
segments.en: "What a fine thing, to have the luck that Mazzarò has!"

segments.fr: diceva la gente;
segments.en: people said;

segments.fr: e non sapeva quel che ci era voluto ad acchiappare quella fortuna:
segments.en: and they didn't know what it had taken to grab that fortune:

segments.fr: quanti pensieri, quante fatiche, quante menzogne,
segments.en: how many worries, how much toil, how many lies,

segments.fr: quanti pericoli di andare in galera,
segments.en: how many risks of going to prison,

segments.fr: e come quella testa che era un brillante
segments.en: and how that head like a diamond

segments.fr: avesse lavorato giorno e notte,
segments.en: had worked day and night,

segments.fr: meglio di una macina del mulino, per fare la roba;
segments.en: better than a millstone, to make property;

segments.fr: e se il proprietario di una chiusa limitrofa
segments.en: and if the owner of a neighbouring field

segments.fr: si ostinava a non cedergliela,
segments.en: stubbornly refused to give it up to him,

segments.fr: e voleva prendere pel collo Mazzarò,
segments.en: and wanted to squeeze Mazzarò by the neck,

segments.fr: dover trovare uno stratagemma per costringerlo a vendere,
segments.en: having to find a trick to force him to sell,

segments.fr: e farcelo cascare, malgrado la diffidenza contadinesca.
segments.en: and make him fall for it, despite peasant mistrust.

segments.fr: Ei gli andava a vantare, per esempio,
segments.en: He would go and praise to him, for example,

segments.fr: la fertilità di una tenuta la quale non produceva nemmeno lupini,
segments.en: the fertility of an estate that didn't even grow lupins,

segments.fr: e arrivava a fargliela credere una terra promessa,
segments.en: and he'd get him to believe it was a promised land,

segments.fr: sinchè il povero diavolo si lasciava indurre a prenderla in affitto,
segments.en: until the poor devil let himself be talked into renting it,

segments.fr: per specularci sopra,
segments.en: to make a profit on it,

segments.fr: e ci perdeva poi il fitto, la casa e la chiusa,
segments.en: and then lost on it the rent, his house and his field,

segments.fr: che Mazzarò se l'acchiappava, per un pezzo di pane.
segments.en: which Mazzarò grabbed for himself, for a piece of bread.

segments.fr: E quante seccature Mazzarò doveva sopportare!
segments.en: And how many nuisances Mazzarò had to put up with!

segments.fr: I mezzadri che venivano a lagnarsi delle malannate,
segments.en: The sharecroppers who came to complain about bad years,

segments.fr: i debitori che mandavano in processione le loro donne
segments.en: the debtors who sent their women in a procession

segments.fr: a strapparsi i capelli e picchiarsi il petto
segments.en: to tear their hair and beat their breasts

segments.fr: per scongiurarlo di non metterli in mezzo alla strada,
segments.en: to beg him not to throw them out on the street,

segments.fr: col pigliarsi il mulo o l'asinello, che non avevano da mangiare.
segments.en: by taking their mule or little donkey, for they had nothing to eat.

segments.fr: «Lo vedete quel che mangio io?» rispondeva lui,
segments.en: "Do you see what I eat?" he would answer,

segments.fr: «pane e cipolla! e sì che ho i magazzini pieni zeppi,
segments.en: "bread and onion! and yet my storehouses are crammed full,

segments.fr: e sono il padrone di tutta questa roba.»
segments.en: and I'm the owner of all this property."

segments.fr: E se gli domandavano un pugno di fave, di tutta quella roba,
segments.en: And if they asked him for a handful of broad beans, out of all that property,

segments.fr: ei diceva: «Che, vi pare che l'abbia rubata?
segments.en: he said: "What, do you think I stole it?

segments.fr: Non sapete quanto costano per seminarle, e zapparle, e raccoglierle?»
segments.en: Don't you know what they cost to sow, and hoe, and gather?"

segments.fr: E se gli domandavano un soldo rispondeva che non l'aveva.
segments.en: And if they asked him for a penny, he answered that he didn't have one.

segments.fr: E non l'aveva davvero.
segments.en: And he really didn't have one.

segments.fr: Chè in tasca non teneva mai dodici tarì,
segments.en: For he never kept twelve tarì in his pocket,

segments.fr: tanti ce ne volevano per far fruttare tutta quella roba,
segments.en: so much did it take to make all that property pay,

segments.fr: e il denaro entrava ed usciva come un fiume dalla sua casa.
segments.en: and money flowed in and out of his house like a river.

segments.fr: Del resto a lui non gliene importava del denaro;
segments.en: Anyway, he didn't care about money;

segments.fr: diceva che non era roba,
segments.en: he said it wasn't property,

segments.fr: e appena metteva insieme una certa somma,
segments.en: and as soon as he put together a certain sum,

segments.fr: comprava subito un pezzo di terra;
segments.en: he immediately bought a piece of land;

segments.fr: perchè voleva arrivare ad avere della terra quanta ne ha il re,
segments.en: because he wanted to end up with as much land as the king has,

segments.fr: ed esser meglio del re,
segments.en: and to be better than the king,

segments.fr: chè il re non può nè venderla, nè dire ch'è sua.
segments.en: for the king can neither sell it, nor say it's his.

segments.fr: Di una cosa sola gli doleva, che cominciasse a farsi vecchio,
segments.en: Only one thing pained him, that he was starting to grow old,

segments.fr: e la terra doveva lasciarla là dov'era.
segments.en: and he would have to leave the land where it was.

segments.fr: Questa è una ingiustizia di Dio,
segments.en: This is an injustice of God,

segments.fr: che dopo di essersi logorata la vita ad acquistare della roba,
segments.en: that after you've worn out your life acquiring property,

segments.fr: quando arrivate ad averla, che ne vorreste ancora, dovete lasciarla!
segments.en: when you finally have it, and you'd like even more, you have to leave it!

segments.fr: E stava delle ore seduto sul corbello, col mento nelle mani,
segments.en: And he sat for hours on the basket, with his chin in his hands,

segments.fr: a guardare le sue vigne che gli verdeggiavano sotto gli occhi,
segments.en: looking at his vineyards growing green before his eyes,

segments.fr: e i campi che ondeggiavano di spighe come un mare,
segments.en: and the fields waving with ears of wheat like a sea,

segments.fr: e gli oliveti che velavano la montagna come una nebbia,
segments.en: and the olive groves veiling the mountain like a mist,

segments.fr: e se un ragazzo seminudo gli passava dinanzi,
segments.en: and if a half-naked boy passed in front of him,

segments.fr: curvo sotto il peso come un asino stanco,
segments.en: bent under his load like a tired donkey,

segments.fr: gli lanciava il suo bastone fra le gambe, per invidia,
segments.en: he threw his stick between the boy's legs, out of envy,

segments.fr: e borbottava: «Guardate chi ha i giorni lunghi!
segments.en: and muttered: "Look who has long days ahead!

segments.fr: costui che non ha niente!»
segments.en: this one, who has nothing!"

segments.fr: Sicché quando gli dissero che era tempo di lasciare la sua roba,
segments.en: So when they told him it was time to leave his property,

segments.fr: per pensare all'anima,
segments.en: to think of his soul,

segments.fr: uscì nel cortile come un pazzo, barcollando,
segments.en: he went out into the courtyard like a madman, staggering,

segments.fr: e andava ammazzando a colpi di bastone le sue anitre e i suoi tacchini,
segments.en: and went about killing his ducks and his turkeys with blows of his stick,

segments.fr: e strillava: «Roba mia, vientene con me!»
segments.en: and screamed: "My property, come away with me!"
